descricao_original: This image is a low magnification, midsagittal section of a human pituitary stained with hematoxylin and eosin. Note the distinct boundaries between the neurohypophyseal and adenohypophyseal tissues, indicating the different embryological origins of these subdivisions. 5x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of slide in the Oklahoma State University slide collection.

marcadores.explicacao_original: The adenohypophysis originates from the oral ectoderm of the embryo as a sac-shaped structure termed Rathke’s pouch. Remnants of this pouch, typically filled with protein (colloid), are visible in the adult.
